name: CSC427 Fall 2025 (Exophobias)
summary: Coursework for UVic's Fall 2025 CSC427 bioinformatics course, organised week by week with a final project. The largest of the student repos: 37 .codon files covering genome assembly, motif matrices, alignment and a Codon port of scanpy preprocessing, with 85 Python interop sites across seventeen files as ported library code reaches back into Python.
why_codon: Course assignments require porting Python bioinformatics code to Codon and comparing runtimes. Inferred from the weekly structure and the CI harness, which installs Codon and Seq and runs both versions.

name: CSC427 Fall 2025 (chase2512)
summary: Coursework for UVic's Fall 2025 CSC427 bioinformatics course, and the entry that shows the discovery method's blind spot. It carries no .codon file at all: the Codon ports are named nj_codon.py, upgma_codon.py and so on, and the week 3 evaluation script runs the Python version and the Codon version of the same code and prints a runtime comparison. Codon compiles .py directly, so an extension search cannot see this repo.
why_codon: Course requirement, and the evaluation script prints a Language/Runtime table comparing Python against the Codon port of the same algorithm.
note: Codon source in .py files. Found only via the codon.jit lane; extension:codon misses it entirely. See docs/gaps.md.
